name: 1 - Stand Down
description: Nice simple route. Run along Higher Lane, turn left onto Ringley Road, turn right along Stand Lane, then turn right on Radcliffe New Road run along until the Goats Gate pub then turn right onto Dales Lane and keep running until you get back to the start.

name: 2 - Threading the Needle Reloaded
description: So cross over the road run around curry house. Left at Egerton, down at Pinfold, up at hamilton down at Church. Go around Goat's gate miss out Church, go down Hamilton, up Pinfold, down Egerton then back to the end.

name: 3 - Prestwich run around
description: From Aldi, down to the subway and over, through that little cut through which brings us out on to Bury Old Road, 1st right on to Nursey Rd, at the bottom turn left along Heys Rd, past Heys Sch, turn left, up the tiny little hill, cross over the road, straight on to where the shops are, left turn on to Mount Rd, over Sandgate, left on to Thatch Leech Lane, at the top turn right back to Aldi.

name: 4 - Whitefield Runaround (Fusiliers)
description: So run up along Higher Lane, crossing when you can find a safe spot before turnning right and coming down Church Ln. Turn left and run towards Bury on the New Road crossing again whenever there is a safe spot. Turn right down Rufford Drive follow this down to the chip shop turn right again along Parr Lane past the gym, turn left and then right onto Albert Road; then follow this along to run across the Fusiliers Meadow if this is closed just go past it and follow the road around. Turn right back onto Thatch Leach Lane, the right onto the Old Road back to the start.

name: 5 - Whitefield OaB (Ringley)
description: Ok most OaB around Whitefield require going up and down big hills or busy roads, not this one. So run out of McD to the left follow Higher Lane until you turn left onto Ringley Rd changing to the other side of the road asap. Keep going for 20 minutes and then turn around.

name: 6 - Bury OaB
description: Run along Bury New Road towards Bury for 20 mins, turn around and run back.

name: 7 - Manchester OaB
description: Run along Bury New Road towards Macnchester for 20 mins, turn around and run back.

name: 8 - Prestwich Loop from Bury Old to New
gpx: ./gpx/Prestwich Loop from Bury Old to New.gpx
description: Nice simple route starting on Bury Old Road run down toward Prestwich keep going until you reach Heaton Park Tram station turn right here. Follow this lane straight on and then at the junction keep going straight again (St Marys Rd). When you reach Bury New Road turn right and follow that all the way back to McD starting point.

name: 9 - Mairead's Circle
description: Run down Higher Lane, down Dales Lane. Right at the Goats Gate along RnR then turn left onto Bury New Road for a short while before turning right onto Rufford Lane, follow that down until you turn right on Parr Lane, then run until you reach the gym turning right just before and run up to Morrisons, turn left onto Bury New Road and return to start.

name: 10 - Dale's Hammer
description: Run up Higher Lane, Left onto Park Lane. Right at Parkstone Ave and then onto Hillingdon / Sunningdale / Old Hall. Right onto Ringley and left down Dales. Right at Goats Gate up RNR the Right at BNR back to the start.

name: 11 - Prestwich via Heaton Edge
description: So from McD cross over to the left side of Bury Old Road then begin the run turning left on Thatch Leach Lane run until the Frigate pub and turn right own Sandgate Road crossing over the the motorway. Keep running until you reach then take a quick shimmy to the left before turning right onto the road next to the reservoir (St Margarets Road) just follow that around until you reach Bury Old Road again.  Turn left for a little run until you take a right along Heys Road (Tattoo parlour) keep following that all the way down into Prestwich town centre. Cross under the tram and run down fairfax then take a right at M&S keep running to run back under the motorway take the left subway back up and return to McD start point.

name: 12 - Whitefield Hills
description: So run along higher lane before turning left through a ginnel to Ringley Chase, run around posh fountain, then back to run right onto Ringley Drive then left onto Ringley Road, then right again down Stand Lane. Turn Right onto Hollinhurst Road to cut the corner. then right on Radcliffe New Road for a little, teeny, tiny uphill bit. Turn right again at the goats gate to run along Dales Lane, Higher Lane to return.

name: 1 - Philips Park 5k
description: From Phillips Park run left down the road then cobbled path towards outwood trail. Then turn left to cross the bridge and take the right path after the bridge and follow the signs for the 13 bridge viaduct until you reach the irwell where we turn left again. Keep running until you get to a junction with four main routes, again turn left following the sign for Phillips Park. You should run very close to a pylon on your right and be next to a little lake that is slightly above you. At this point carry straight on into the wooded section following the sign for Mere Clough where you should be running with a little stream on your right. Keep running until the end of this path where you will see a short uphill section to your left. Take this and at the top take a small path left that will again take you across a bridge then turn left to return to the gate.

name: 2 - Phillips Park to Drinkwater
description: Run into Phillips down and then up the road to the main car park entrance. Keep going down the hill (enjoy the view), keep going past the house and gardens then take next left onto a main path. This will lead you to the little lake at this point turn right following the sign for the Arches viaduct, (unless you have had enough already and you want to take mere clough), until you reach the Irwell where you again turn right following the sign for Drinkwater park, follow that path which after a while will have a quick uphill, flatten, then have a quick down hill. When you come down that hill turn left and follow the path which is parallel(ish)to the one you have ran down on there will be signs pointing you allong the sculpture trail. We will regroup here anyway in our groups as always.

name: 3 - Hurst wood and Old Hall Farm
description: So run up to the parkfield pub turn left and follow the road. Keep going straight down a small road that will turn into a ginnel around the back of the houses (if you run with us a lot you have done this the other way around ;-) then turn right following the main road up the hill, once you reach the top turn left again onto Copper Lane. Follow that down and into hurst wood, taking the main path that goes straight on follow that down. Once you reach a sign next to a lonesome tree you have two choices go right for the 6k, left for the 5k. Either way follow the path which will lead down onto the outwood trail. Turn left again onto the trail and the run along outwood trail until you get to a junction and the path splits. To your left you will see a stile go over that and you will start to go up hill.  Get to the top and follow the very clear path until you reach a farm, once through turn right and go down old hall lane until you reach Phillips Park Lane turn left and return to the finish.

name: 4 - Phillips Park Lane OaB
description: Run out from Phillips Park down hill towards the Outwood Trail, careful down the steep bit then turn right along the outwood trail. Keep running for 20 minutes and then turn back.

name: 5 - Lagoonacy
description: So run down from Phillips Park along the motorway, run down the hill then across and down the hill again. Run straight along close to the motorway, might be a bit muddy. At the end where you hit the Irwell turn right to run along a towpath then run along this until you see a steel gate. Try opening it, if it opens follow the road through taking it right when it goes right to a gate on the other side where there is gap on the right to go around the gate. Turn right to follow a route parallel to the Outwood trail, keep going until you see a clear path to the left go up this, and then you should see a stile in front of you go over that and follow the path uphill until you see old hall lane then turn right and return to the start

name: 6 - Into Phillips Park without cobbles
description: Run into Phillips down and then up the road to the main car park entrance. Keep going down the hill (enjoy the view), keep going past the house and gardens and then keep running down through a big open area. Keep running down past kingfisher thingie until you reach a tunnel go through that an then a quick right and follow the path to the left along the motorway run along this until the end then turn left and run back  until your reach our normal route through Drinkwater park just keep running straight along until you reach our 4 way sign, we will probably active regroup here and have people run back to people at the back. Otherwise turn left towards Mere Clough. Enjoy this and then the teeny tiny hill at the end  to take the bridge across the motorway before turning left and returning to Philips

name: 7 - Phillips Park OaB but not along Prestwich Clough
gpx: ./gpx/Phillips Park OaB but not along Prestwich Clough.gpx
description: Run into Phillips down and then up the road to the main car park entrance. Keep going down the hill (enjoy the view), keep going past the house and gardens then take next left onto a main path. This will lead you to the little lake. This is where you will return to as part of your OaB so just start running straight along and you will reach a main gate and side road. Follow that road to the left you will get to some walls and another another main gate ,cross that and  go through the gate in front of you. Follow that into prestwich clough, when in doubt choose the low route. Keep running until you hit 20 minutes and then turn around. If you manage to get to St Mary's Park in Prestwich in 20 minutes well done you get a small lolly.

name: 8 - Hurst Wood - the wrong way round
gpx: ./gpx/Philips Park, Outwood and Hurst Wood, the wrong way round.gpx
description: So run down Phillips Park Road down to Outwood, turn right and run along to Hurst Wood entrances, options given on the night.  Run up Hurst Wood then Copper Lane then run down Old Hall Lane and left back to base.
